nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor and changeable via changeOwner.
Address of the bankroll account that receives dividends and holds ZTH approvals.
Counter of total number of spins performed.
Accumulated total of ZTH tokens wagered.
Tracked ZTH balance of the contract, increased on spin and reduced on payout.
Boolean flag controlling whether betting is enabled; toggled by pauseGame/resumeGame.
Address of the ZTH token contract accepted for bets.
Bankroll address passed in the constructor and used for token approvals.
ZTHInterface instance used to transfer/approve ZTH tokens.
Mapping of allowed wager amounts (5,10,25,50 ZTH and owner-added amounts).
Mapping of player address to pending spin struct (tokenValue, blockn).
Constructor: stores Zethr/bankroll addresses, sets owner = msg.sender, grants infinite approvals and seeds valid bets.
Payable fallback that simply accepts ETH.
ERC223 tokenFallback entry point that packages the transfer into a TKN struct and calls _spinTokens.
Private spin executor: validates sender, bet size, jackpot guard, records the spin and finishes a previous one.
Public wrapper (gameIsActive) that finishes the caller's pending spin and returns the result.
Private spin settlement: derives the random result, computes profit and transfers the payout.
View check ensuring 25x the wager does not exceed half of contractBalance.
View randomness source hashing blockhash(blockn) with an entropy address.
Internal helper returning maxRandom(blockn, entropy) % upper.
View returning the tracked contractBalance.
Owner-only function adding a new valid wager amount.
Owner-only function setting gameActive to false.
Owner-only function setting gameActive to true.
Owner-only function transferring ownership.
Owner-only function changing the bankroll address.
Owner-only function forwarding the contract ETH balance to the bankroll.
Owner-only function transferring remaining tokens to owner and self-destructing.
Private view verifying that the calling token contract is the registered ZTH token.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller used for ownership, spin target and access control.
ZTHTKN.transfer(target, profit) external token payout performed before state reset in _finishSpin.
selfdestruct(owner) destroying the contract and forcing ETH to the owner.
bankroll.transfer(address(this).balance) ETH transfer to an arbitrary bankroll address.
ZTHTKN.transfer(owner, contractBalance) sweeping all tracked tokens to the owner.
ZTHTKN.approve of 2**256-1 to bankroll and owner during construction.
Profit multiplication of spin.tokenValue by jackpot/multiplier factors.
contractBalance.sub(profit) accounting reduction executed together with the payout.
Parameter _from of tokenFallback, the token sender address.
Parameter _value of tokenFallback, the token amount transferred.
Parameter _tkn (TKN struct) of _spinTokens carrying sender and value.
Local _customerAddress = _tkn.sender inside _spinTokens.
Local _wagered = _tkn.value inside _spinTokens.
Memory playerSpin loaded from playerSpins inside _spinTokens.
Parameter target (player address) of _finishSpin.
Memory playerSpin of the target inside _finishSpin.
Local profit amount computed in _finishSpin.
Local random result used for win/lose branching in _finishSpin.
Parameter _wager of jackpotGuard.
Local maxProfit = _wager * 25 in jackpotGuard.
Local halfContractBalance = contractBalance / 2 in jackpotGuard.
Parameter blockn (past block number) of maxRandom.
Parameter entropy address of maxRandom.
Parameter upper modulus of random.
Parameter _tokenAmount of addNewBetAmount.
Parameter _newOwner of changeOwner.
Parameter _newBankroll of changeBankroll.
Constructor parameter ZethrAddress (ZTH token contract).
Constructor parameter BankrollAddress.

changeOwner overwrites the owner state variable.
changeBankroll overwrites the bankroll state variable.
addNewBetAmount enables a new entry in validTokenBet.
Payable fallback increases the contract ETH balance backing the game.
tokenFallback forwards the incoming token transfer into _spinTokens.
_spinTokens requires _zthToken(msg.sender) before processing.
_zthToken compares the caller token contract against ZTHTKNADDR.
msg.sender drives the token-origin validation and player identity in _spinTokens.
_spinTokens requires validTokenBet[_tkn.value].
_spinTokens requires gameActive to be true.
_spinTokens calls jackpotGuard to bound the maximum payout.
jackpotGuard reads contractBalance to compute the payout ceiling.
_spinTokens adds the wager to contractBalance.
_spinTokens calls _finishSpin to settle a previously pending spin.
_spinTokens reads the stored playerSpin from playerSpins.
_spinTokens writes the new spin struct into playerSpins.
_spinTokens increments totalSpins.
_spinTokens accumulates totalZTHWagered.
finishSpin delegates settlement to _finishSpin.
gameIsActive modifier gates the public finishSpin entry point.
finishSpin settles the spin belonging to the untrusted msg.sender.
_finishSpin loads the target player's spin from playerSpins.
_finishSpin clears the player's spin struct after settlement.
_finishSpin calls random to derive the game result.
random delegates to maxRandom for the entropy hash.
maxRandom returns the pseudo-random value used by _finishSpin.
_finishSpin computes profit by multiplying spin.tokenValue with multiplier factors.
_finishSpin reduces contractBalance by the profit.
_finishSpin performs the external token payout to the winning player.
The payout amount is derived from tracked contractBalance/profit before state reset.
The payout is executed through the ZTH token instance.
The external token transfer can re-enter _finishSpin before playerSpins is cleared.
An ERC223 token transfer invokes tokenFallback, allowing callback re-entry.
divertDividendsToBankroll sends the ETH balance to bankroll.
bankroll is the destination of the ETH transfer.
testingSelfDestruct transfers the contract token balance to owner.
The sweep transfer is executed through the ZTH token instance.
owner is the recipient of the token sweep.
testingSelfDestruct destroys the contract.
owner receives the forced ETH from selfdestruct.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from only feeds the TKN struct sender used by tokenFallback.
Parameter _value only feeds the TKN struct value validated in tokenFallback.
The TKN struct parameter is consumed entirely by _spinTokens.
Local _customerAddress is only used for the TokensWagered event and spin bookkeeping in _spinTokens.
Local _wagered is the validated bet amount handled inside _spinTokens.
The memory playerSpin is loaded, updated and stored back only in _spinTokens.
Parameter target selects the playerSpins entry settled by _finishSpin.
The memory spin struct is only read/written within _finishSpin.
Local profit is the exact amount passed to the external token payout.
Local result governs the win/lose branching inside _finishSpin.
Parameter _wager is used solely to bound the jackpot in jackpotGuard.
Local maxProfit is an intermediate value of jackpotGuard.
Local halfContractBalance is an intermediate value of jackpotGuard.
Parameter blockn selects the past blockhash in maxRandom.
Parameter entropy is packed with the blockhash in maxRandom.
Parameter upper is the modulus applied in random.
Parameter _tokenAmount is the mapping key written by addNewBetAmount.
Parameter _newOwner is assigned to the owner state variable.
Parameter _newBankroll is assigned to the bankroll state variable.
Constructor parameter sets ZTHTKNADDR/ZTHTKN.
Constructor parameter sets ZTHBANKROLL/bankroll.
